author: Tobias Jakobs
name: geoJSON_export
description: Exports the geotag location data of selected images into a geoJSON file, generating thumbnails for use on a map.
description-extensive: This tool takes the GPS location information stored in your photos and creates a map-ready geoJSON file, complete with small preview images. You can use the result to plot where your pictures were taken on a map. It needs the ImageMagick 'convert' tool along with common Linux utilities (mkdir, xdg-open, xdg-user-dir), and it has only been tested on Linux.
